# Kyrazo

> Dedicated webhook infrastructure for enterprise B2B. Physically isolated compute, databases, and delivery workers — zero noisy-neighbor degradation, zero shared database memory.

Kyrazo is a managed webhook gateway: ingest, verify, queue, and dispatch events on infrastructure reserved exclusively for one customer. Unlike shared-queue platforms, each deployment runs on its own VMs, database, and delivery workers.

## Product

- Isolated compute, database, and delivery workers per customer
- Signature verification, payload normalization, retries with exponential backoff
- Professional plan from $499/month on an annual contract
- Enterprise BYOC / private cloud with custom SLAs, SAML/SSO, and compliance
